name: prompt-ladder
description: Claude does what you ask, so ask well. Press ctrl+x ctrl+p on a rough draft and prompt-ladder writes a well-built prompt from your session's own context, at the cost you pick: quick, balanced or deep.

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.description: How many rungs to write. 3: quick, balanced, deep. 2: the pair that fits the task (quick+balanced for small work, balanced+deep for large).

autofill.title: Fill the recommended rung
autofill.description: Put the recommended candidate in the prompt box when the rewrite lands, as long as you have not edited the draft meanwhile. Off: the box keeps your draft until you pick.

handoffAt.title: Hand off at (k tokens)
handoffAt.description: Once the session's context reaches this many thousand tokens, balanced and deep start by leaving a handoff and continue fresh (new session or subagent). 0 turns it off.
